landing.metaTitle: PartOn — Find shifts, fill your team
landing.metaDescription: Workers discover short shifts; employers fill seats with a clear token model.
landing.heroTitle: Shift work ready for the day
landing.heroSubtitle: Mobile app for workers; token model and operational trust for employers.
landing.sectionWorkersBody: One-tap apply, 3-hour confirm windows, and branch check-in built for the field.
landing.sectionEmployersBody: Publish jobs, hold tokens before spend, and review applicants in one flow.
landing.bandBody: Cream and forest palette readable in daylight; calm under time pressure.

pricing.metaDescription: How employer tokens and provision work on PartOn.
pricing.title: Predictable cost with tokens
pricing.intro: Each published shift reserves tokens; accepted applications settle the cost.

legalPrivacy.p1: PartOn processes personal data as a data controller under applicable law.
legalPrivacy.p2: Phone, check-in location, documents, and transaction logs are processed to provide the service.
legalPrivacy.p3: Contact support for access, correction, and erasure requests.

legalTerms.p1: By using the platform you accept obligations for worker and employer roles.
legalTerms.p2: Misleading listings or fraudulent check-in may lead to restrictions.
legalTerms.p3: Policy updates are communicated through in-app acceptance.
